pages.text: Mod allows you to add some plants to the pot that did not have this function before. These are: $(li)Grass,$(li)Seagrass,$(li)Sugar Cane,$(li)Vine,$(li)Big Drip Leaf,$(li)Small Drip Leaf,$(li)Kelp$(br)

$(br)The same with: $(li)Fern,$(li)Bamboo,$(li)Cactus$(br2)have a colored version$(br2)Potted plants have improvements that you can read about in the chapter: $(l:basics/potted_plants_feature)Potted Plants Features$()$(br)
